hostApi.description: The host API the scripts are written against. The hub refuses a value outside the set it serves, and the runner refuses one that differs from its own.

builder.description: A service that runs in the build stage before `compose build`, alone on the outside network and binding only the run's build copy of the commit, for downloads that do not fit a Dockerfile.

expectedServices.description: The services the boot stage waits for: each must run and, when it has a healthcheck, be healthy. A one-shot service is ready when it exits 0. Leave out services that start only under a profile.

networkOnlyKeys.description: Accepted for compatibility; the hub does not read it.

dirty.description: Paths whose uncommitted changes refuse a submit, so local edits are never silently left out. The run always reads the commit.

name.description: The source name flows pass to `ctx.readSource` and `ctx.listSource`.

runnerSources.description: Directories of the commit copied read-only into the runner at `/work/source/<name>`, for `ctx.readSource` and `ctx.listSource`.

inputs.description: Local inputs of a submit besides the commit.

files.description: The compose files in order. The hub adds its harness file last, which removes every published `ports` entry of the consumer.

forbidden.description: Substrings no file name of the set may contain, so a file meant for local use never enters a sealed run.

projectDirectory.description: The directory compose resolves relative paths against; the repository root when omitted.

compose.description: The compose file set of the run.

name.description: The edge name: collectors reach the port as `http://<name>/...`, `databases[].port` names it, and run.env carries `RUN_PORT_<NAME>`.

offset.description: The slot in the run's port block: the host port is the block base plus the offset, from 0 to 98. 99 is reserved for the seal probe.

service.description: The compose service behind the port.

port.description: The container port of that service.

display.description: The label the screen and the kit README show for the port.

open.description: How the port is offered: `browser` at `http://<run id>.localhost:<port>`, an origin of its own per run; `link` at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`; `copy` as an address to copy, for a port that is not HTTP.

ports.description: Services published on `127.0.0.1` while the run's environment is up.

key.description: The run.env variable (`IMG_...`) holding the key. Use it in the image tag of a built service, such as `image: shop-api:${IMG_API}`, and the build stage skips an image that is present.

inputs.description: The paths whose git object ids the key hashes, together with the compose files.

images.description: Content keys for built images, so a commit whose image inputs did not change reuses the image it built before.

command.description: The argv. It runs with the extracted commit mounted writable at `/src` as the working directory, as the hub's user, under umask 077.

image.description: The image the command runs in, pinned by digest. It must have `/bin/sh`, and it runs with no network, a read-only root and no capabilities.

outputs.description: The files the command writes. Each one is a value source of the run redactor. `.env` in the compose project directory becomes the env file of every compose call, and an output named `e2e.private.env.json` becomes the runner's private env.

env.description: The credential generator, run once per run before compose starts.

format.description: `dotenv` reads the value of each key, `json` every string leaf, `pem` each body line of its PEM blocks.

sources.description: Files of the run read as value sources of the run redactor, usually env outputs. At least one is required.

publicNames.description: Dotenv keys or JSON field names whose values are not secret and stay readable.

patterns.description: RE2 expressions; every match is masked in addition to the values of the sources.

secrets.description: The files whose values are credentials of the run.

port.description: The `ports` name that publishes the database.

readSchemas.description: For PostgreSQL, the schemas of `database` the reader may select from; for MySQL, the databases.

ownerRole.description: PostgreSQL only: the role that creates tables after the collectors start, so the reader can also select from them.

rootSecret.description: A key of a `dotenv` source in `secrets.sources` that holds the root password.

rootUser.description: The user the hub logs in as to create the reader; `postgres` or `root` when omitted.

database.description: For PostgreSQL, the database to connect to (`postgres` when omitted); for MySQL, the default database for unqualified table names, which must be one of `readSchemas`.

databases.description: Databases collectors read through `ctx.sql`. The hub logs in as the root user only to create a read-only user for the run, and reads as that user.

allow.description: Allowed argv prefixes. An exec passes when its argv starts with one of them, and the first element must be a program, not a shell.

dir.description: The directory the runner sees as `/work/scripts`; `env.json` sits at its top.

suites.description: The suites directory inside `dir`: each `<name>.ts` whose name is a suite name is a suite.

collectors.description: The collectors directory inside `dir`: each `<id>.ts` is a collector.

notes.description: Text added to the run's kit README, shown on the screen's Environment page and in `env/README.md`.

kit.description: The handoff text for a person using the run's environment.

title: declaration
description: The project declaration `.cockpit/project.yaml`, read from the submitted commit. Paths are relative to the repository root.
